**Ph.D. in Literary Theory and Comparative Literature (Doutorado em Letras), Universidade de São Paulo (USP), 2014–2018** (defended 3 October 2018). Dissertation: *Franz Kafka e Walter Benjamin: Contar do tempo interrompido* (“Narrating Interrupted Time”). Advisor: Jorge Mattos Brito de Almeida. Research period at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin (Prof. Joseph Vogl), 2017. CAPES fellowship.

**M.A. in Literary Theory and History (Mestrado em Teoria e História Literária), Unicamp, 2010–2013.** Dissertation: *Origem negativa na literatura de Franz Kafka: “O castelo” e outras narrativas* (2013). Advisor: Jeanne Marie Gagnebin de Bons. FAPESP fellowship. Research period at Universität zu Köln (Prof. Manuela Günter), 2010–2011.
**B.A. in Literary Studies (Estudos Literários), Unicamp, 2006–2009.** Thesis: *Das portas na obra de Franz Kafka* (2009). Advisor: Jeanne Marie Gagnebin de Bons. FAPESP fellowship.

**2025–present.** DFG Research Unit FOR 5710 “Infrastructure: Aesthetics and Supply” (GEPRIS project no. 524611401), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft. Principal Investigator of subproject TP 4 “Extractivism and Infrastructure in Brazilian Literature”. Spokesperson of the Research Unit: Jörn Etzold.
